stem:
Linear parent function f is graphed on the grid.

Which graph best represents h(x) = -f(x) + 3?

options.label: F
options.text: Graph with a line going upward from bottom left to top right, passing through (0,0)

options.label: H
options.text: Graph with a line going downward from top left to bottom right, passing through (0,3)

options.label: G
options.text: Graph with a line going downward from top left to bottom right, passing through (0,0)

options.label: J
options.text: Graph with a line going upward from bottom left to top right, passing through (0,3)

visual_elements: graph of linear parent function f with line y=x passing through origin
four graphs labeled F, H, G, J with linear lines shown as described in options
notes: The original parent function is y=x, so -f(x) is y=-x reflected about x-axis, then +3 shifts it up by 3, which matches graph H.
